Shape: **Routine** — fixture Git policy and serial scenario execution have clear, test-only fixes.

Production disables automatic maintenance (`internal/gitcredential/environment.go:35`); fixture Git commands omit it. A detached maintenance descendant racing TempDir cleanup is the probable cause matching the reported CI `unlinkat .git/objects: directory not empty`; the sandbox could not reproduce it. No reproduction gate.

1. In `internal/lease/manager_test.go`, add a shared test-only Git command constructor prepending `-c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false`. Route all five direct Git launches (lines 39, 315, 684, 691, 741) through it, preserving working directories, identity flags, output handling, and stdin.
2. Route `reconciliationFixture.git` and the conflicts `update-index` command through it (`internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile_test.go:30,237`). Add a focused regression test in manager_test.go checking effective policy despite contrary repository configuration.
3. Add `t.Parallel()` before fixture creation in each invalid-input subtest (`checkpoint_reconcile_test.go:187`). Preserve all 30 scenarios and assertions.
4. Add `changes/unreleased/244-lease-fixture-git-policy.md`; include probable cause and reproduction limitation in the PR description.

## HANDOFF

Entry points above; extend existing manager/reconciliation fixtures. Commands: TEST_PLAN.md. Checked: fixtures allocate independent TempDirs (`manager_test.go:26`, `checkpoint_reconcile_test.go:51`); neither file uses Setenv/Chdir; Go 1.26 loop semantics apply (`go.mod:3`). **What this change breaks:** shared helper callers inherit disabled maintenance; preserve their behavior and assertions, production policy, docs, and templates unchanged. Search found seven direct Git launches, all covered above. Fragment absent in supplied snapshot; approved-base absence needs coordinator verification because Git metadata is unavailable. Reopen if parallelism exposes shared state or the exact stress command exceeds 10m; do not increase timeout or reduce coverage. Expected to fit the 16h budget.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> The acceptance criteria were narrowed after the sandbox could not reproduce the race: plan the fixture git policy hardening and the default-timeout speedup directly, with no reproduction gate. Keep the plan compact.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

1. **Fixture policy:** audit all seven launches with `grep -n 'exec.Command("git"' internal/lease/{manager,checkpoint_reconcile}_test.go`; only the shared constructor should remain. Run added effective-policy regression with `go test -run '^TestFixtureGitPolicy$' ./internal/lease/` (name the test accordingly); confirm both settings override contrary repo config.
2. **Default-timeout speed:** run exactly `go test -race -count=50 -run 'TestCheckpointReconciliationRejectsInvalidInputs' ./internal/lease/`, without timeout/parallelism overrides; record elapsed time and all scenarios passing.
3. **Cause disclosure:** review PR description for probable detached-maintenance/TempDir cleanup cause, reported CI evidence, and explicit sandbox non-reproduction.
4. **Assertions/full checks:** compare implementation diff against baseline: all scenarios and assertions unchanged. Run `make check`, plus approved `go build ./...` and `go test ./...`; formatting, vet, and staticcheck are covered by make check. Confirm changelog fragment exists. These are implementation-phase checks, not claims of planning-phase execution.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> The acceptance criteria were narrowed after the sandbox could not reproduce the race: plan the fixture git policy hardening and the default-timeout speedup directly, with no reproduction gate. Keep the plan compact.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# Implementation Summary (Issue #244)

## What we learned

- The 50-run checkpoint-reconciliation race probe can exceed Go's default 10-minute package timeout; use verbose output and an explicit timeout for diagnostics, and report the exact acceptance command's result separately.
- Git 2.53 can launch maintenance with `--detach` yet exit before its parent when no task is eligible; use Trace2 descendant timing, and expect ptrace-based tracing to be denied in agent sandboxes.

## Working Tree Changes
```text
 M internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile_test.go
 M internal/lease/manager_test.go
?? changes/unreleased/244-lease-fixture-git-policy.md
```

## Diff Stat
```text
AGENTS.md                                   | 15 ++++++++++
 internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile_test.go |  5 ++--
 internal/lease/manager_test.go              | 43 +++++++++++++++++++++++++----
 3 files changed, 56 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)
```

## Developer report

# Implementation

Completed the approved fixture-only change for ISSUE-244.

- Added `fixtureGitCommand` in `internal/lease/manager_test.go`, prepending `-c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false`, matching production's automatic maintenance settings.
- Routed all seven existing fixture Git launch sites through it, preserving working directories, identity flags, stdin, and output handling.
- Added `TestFixtureGitPolicy`, verifying both effective settings override contrary repository-local configuration and confirming that contrary configuration was stored.
- Added `t.Parallel()` before fixture creation in the 30 independent invalid-input subtests. All scenario names, mutations, and assertions remain unchanged.
- Added `changes/unreleased/244-lease-fixture-git-policy.md`.

## Cause and proposed PR description

Lease test fixtures previously allowed automatic Git maintenance. A detached Git maintenance descendant racing `t.TempDir` cleanup is the probable cause, matching the reported CI `unlinkat .git/objects: directory not empty` evidence. The sandbox could not reproduce the original cleanup race. The fixture commands now disable automatic maintenance as production Git does; independent rejection scenarios run in parallel so the repeated race test completes within the default timeout. All adversarial assertions are preserved.

## Verification

- `go build ./...`: passed.
- `go vet ./internal/lease`: passed.
- `go test -run '^TestFixtureGitPolicy$' ./internal/lease/`: passed (0.021s).
- `go tool staticcheck ./internal/lease`: passed.
- `time go test -race -count=50 -run 'TestCheckpointReconciliationRejectsInvalidInputs' ./internal/lease/`: passed (package 108.058s; wall 1m52.373s), no timeout or parallelism overrides.
- `gofmt -w internal/lease/manager_test.go internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile_test.go` and `gofmt -s -l` on those files: formatted, no findings.
- `grep -n 'exec.Command("git"' internal/lease/manager_test.go internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile_test.go`: only the shared constructor remains.
- `diff -u` against copies saved before editing, plus a Python comparison reversing only the intended reconciliation edits: all reconciliation scenarios and assertions unchanged.
- Git status unavailable: this is the expected task snapshot without Git metadata. Source copies supplied the comparison baseline.

## HANDOFF

Changed behavior: fixture Git cannot launch automatic maintenance; independent invalid-input rejection scenarios run in parallel. Production code is unchanged.

Changed files: `internal/lease/manager_test.go`, `internal/lease/checkpoint_reconcile_test.go`, `changes/unreleased/244-lease-fixture-git-policy.md`, and this implementation artifact. No other active artifacts were changed.

The coordinator must include the proposed cause disclosure above in the PR description; PR publication is outside the developer snapshot. Original cleanup-race reproduction remains unavailable, as expected by the approved plan. Commands and observed results are recorded above. The single full-suite run passed: `make check` exited 0, covering repository-wide formatting checks, `go vet ./...`, `go tool staticcheck ./...`, and `go test -race ./...`. A separate `go test ./...` was intentionally not run because the operator permits at most one full suite; the race-enabled suite supplies the broader validation. Full output is in the scratch log `244-make-check.log`. No acceptance check remains failing; PR text must be carried forward by the coordinator.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> The developer writes only source, tests, docs, IMPLEMENTATION.md and LESSONS.md; changing any other file under .swarm/active/ discards the whole run. Tests that need loopback sockets must t.Skip when the sandbox denies them. Run go build ./... and go vet on changed packages, then targeted tests; at most one full suite.
